rationale: I read the complete held EO 12246 (45 FR 68367, Oct. 15, 1980, signed Oct. 10, 1980, Cuban and Haitian Entrants): sec. 1-101 delegates the President's functions under sec. 501(c) of the Refugee Education Assistance Act of 1980 to the Secretary of State, and sec. 1-102 requires the Secretary to promptly provide assistance for entrants at Fort Indiantown Gap, Fort McCoy, Fort Chaffee, Fort Allen and Florida sites; it has no own term. I read the held full text of EO 12251 (45 FR 76085, Nov. 18, 1980, signed Nov. 15, 1980, same title): secs. 1-101 to 1-104 re-delegate the sec. 501(a)-(c) functions to the Secretary of Health and Human Services (repeating the site-assistance direction), sec. 1-105 states 'Executive Order No. 12246 of October 10, 1980, is revoked.' and sec. 1-106 'This Order is effective November 15, 1980.' That names EO 12246 by number and date, reaches all of it, and has no exception or savings clause. D6 self-check: the OFR note says 'Revoked by: EO 12251, November 15, 1980' (it dates 12246 Oct. 10 or Oct. 15 in different fields; the held text controls: signed Oct. 10, 1980, published Oct. 15). A text search of the held full-run texts finds EO 12246 named only in EO 12251; I found no later order that revives the Secretary of State delegation, extends the revoked order, or revokes EO 12251's revocation. The 1989 snapshot row is empty and no own term ran out earlier. Provisional NO hypothesis; the effective end (Nov. 15, 1980 per sec. 1-106) is not otherwise adjudicated.
